notes: UNV has {<WH03605>} as implicit (כָל), but LCC '萬彙' explicitly covers 'all host', so braces dropped per Rule 3.
Both H3605 (כָל) and H6635 (צְבָאָם) attached to 萬彙 since LCC merges the two concepts into one phrase (Rule 6).
與其 (and their) has no independent SN — these are Chinese connective words covering the Hebrew conjunctive prefix וְ which is bundled into the adjacent SNs.
